llc.formation_notes: Fee set by 950 CMR 112.29 ($500). Third-party sites report an extra $20 for online/fax filing; not verified on the Secretary of the Commonwealth site (blocked to automated reading).

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: on or before the anniversary date of the filing of the original certificate of organization

sources.title: 950 CMR 112.00 annual report rule
sources.quote: Each limited liability company shall file an annual report with the Division on or before the anniversary date of the filing of its original certificate of organization.

entity_level_taxes.name: Corporate excise minimum (S corporations)
entity_level_taxes.notes: S corporations pay the non-income measure ($2.60 per $1,000 of tangible property or net worth) with a $456 minimum.

entity_level_taxes.name: S corporation entity-level income measure (receipts $6M to <$9M)
entity_level_taxes.notes: Applies only when total receipts are $6 million or more; 3% when receipts are $9 million or more. Not relevant for most small S corps.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Chapter 63D PTE excise: 5% of qualified members' income (since 2021). New chapter 63E PTE excise: 4% of members' share above the surtax threshold, for tax years beginning on/after 2026-01-01 (St. 2026, c. 101). Both expire if the federal SALT cap expires.

sources.title: Massachusetts Tax Rates (DOR)
sources.quote: S Corporations ... Total receipts $6 million or more but less than $9 million (net income) 2% ... Minimum $456

sources.title: Elective Pass-Through Entity Excise (DOR)
sources.quote: The chapter 63D excise is an excise equal to 5% of a PTE's income that is attributable to qualified members and subject to tax under chapter 62.

personal_exemption.notes: Head of household $6,800. Amounts read on the 2025 Form 1 (latest published); 2026 form not yet published.

income_tax_2026.starting_point: own definition (Massachusetts gross income, Part A/B/C)
income_tax_2026.surtaxes: 4% surtax on taxable income over $1,107,750 for tax year 2026 ($1,083,150 for 2025). Short-term capital gains 8.5%, collectibles 12%.

sources.title: Massachusetts Tax Rates (DOR)
sources.quote: Tax year 2026 : For income exceeding $1,107,750, there is an additional surtax of 4% .

sources.title: 2026 Form 1-ES
sources.quote: The surtax threshold for tax year 2026 is $1,107,750.

sources.title: 2025 Form 1
sources.quote: Personal exemptions. Single/Married filing separately ($4,400), Head of household ($6,800), Married filing jointly ($8,800)

estimated_tax.required_if: expect to owe more than $400 in taxes on income not subject to withholding
estimated_tax.notes: Taxpayers subject to the 4% surtax must file and pay electronically.

unemployment_2026.notes: New employers (registered < 3 years) 2.42%; new construction employers 6.08%. Experienced 2026 range 0.94%-14.37% plus COVID recovery assessment. Wage base believed $15,000 (G.L. c.151A s.14) but malegislature.gov was unreachable and the DUA page does not state it.

notable: No LLC franchise tax, but both the Certificate of Organization and the annual report cost $500, among the highest in the US (https://www.mass.gov/doc/950-cmr-112-limited-liability-companies/download)
4% millionaire surtax threshold rises to $1,107,750 for 2026 (https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massachusetts-tax-rates)
New for 2026: a second elective PTE excise (ch. 63E, 4%) lets pass-throughs deduct the surtax at entity level (https://www.mass.gov/service-details/elective-pass-through-entity-excise)
S corporations owe at least the $456 minimum corporate excise every year (https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massachusetts-tax-rates)
No local income taxes in Massachusetts.
uncertain: 2026 personal exemption amounts taken from the 2025 Form 1 ($4,400/$8,800); 2026 Form 1 not published yet.
SUTA taxable wage base ($15,000 by statute) not read on an official page today: malegislature.gov refused connection.
Online filing surcharge (+$20 reported by third parties) and late annual report penalty not verified: sec.state.ma.us blocks automated access.
Paid Family and Medical Leave contributions not researched.
